replicated_originals.reference: Wiersma, Nienhuis, Slooff & Giel (1998) Natural course of schizophrenic disorders: A 15-year followup of a Dutch incidence cohort (Schizophrenia Bulletin 24:75-85)

A.reason: This 1998 Soc Psychiatry Psychiatr Epidemiol paper on needs for care (same Groningen cohort authors) does not appear in the reference list or text; the only Wiersma 1998 work cited is the Schizophrenia Bulletin paper.

B.reason: Aims state the study replicates 'a study on suicide risk two decades later in the same catchment area (cf. Wiersma et al. 1998)' (ref 4); suicide survival is compared directly with the Wiersma 1973-1988 cohort (log-rank test, 11.0% vs 2.4%).

notes: Replication is a cohort re-study (new PROGR-S 2000-2009 sample, same catchment area) of the suicide rate reported by Wiersma et al. 1998; the authors frame it as a replication hypothesizing a lower rate, and found a significant decline. Text sometimes cites Wiersma as [3] (Fig 2 caption, Discussion) though the reference list places it at 4 -- a citation-number slip in the paper, not a candidate metadata issue.
